setup_denoising_task: setup a fairseq DenoisingTask from args to load dictionary and configure masking parameters
load_denoising_dataset: load a denoising dataset split with token blocking and masking for BART-style training
build_inference_dataset: build a nested dictionary dataset for inference with source tokens and prev output tokens
configure_denoising_args: configure denoising task arguments like mask ratio, rotation, permutation, and insert rates
get_max_positions: get the max source and target sequence positions allowed by the denoising task
